description: Public onboarding tool (no API key required). Emails a free UK company API key (1,000 checks each calendar month) to a corporate work address (not a personal webmail address) and returns the key details. Returns JSON with fields status, maskedEmail, allowanceCalls, expiresInDays, financeApprovalUrl, slackMessageForFinance.

companyName.description: Legal or trading name of your organisation.

intendedUse.description: Optional summary of intended integration or data use.

workEmail.description: Corporate work email address (personal webmail domains are rejected).
